possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports no details on model design, training, or evaluation process beyond a brief summary, and the developer states the model has not been aligned for safety.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes training data only as synthetic instructions and hand-curated public instructions, without dataset sizes, curation details, or synthetic generation process.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not document how the Indonesian/dialect instruction data was collected, curated, or used, nor the synthetic data generation process.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: The model is fine-tuned on synthetic instructions and hand-curated public instructions, which may not capture the full complexity of real-world Indonesian/dialect language use.

possible_risks.description: Historical and societal biases might be present in data that are used to train and fine-tune models. Biases can also be inherited from seed data or exacerbated by synthetic data generation methods.
possible_risks.justification: The fine-tuning data consists of synthetic and hand-curated public instructions, which can inherit or amplify societal and historical biases.

training_context.training_data: The model is a fine-tune of Gemma2 9B, trained on synthetic instructions and publicly available instructions hand-curated by the team with native-speaker assistance.
